It belongs LOWER — further from V1, the туалет’s own vent shaft, and hugging G4b, the туалет’s south wall. The only sewer stack in the record is SS-B, DN110, in P1 in the туалет — about 6 m away — and no photo shows how this DN50 reaches it, or whether P2 holds a second riser instead. The photo shows the pipe entering the chase and nothing beyond, so that is where the line ends and the callout says so. There is no horizontal main across this flat. What I did wrong is not the reading — it is that the reading FIT TOO WELL. Two midpoints from one sentence both landed on my route, and y=152 landed inside P1’s span, and I called that corroboration. It was not: a 250 mm-wide corridor between two fixed obstacles has a midline whatever runs along it, and P1 spans 80 px so almost any y hits it. I checked BEFORE drawing and still fooled myself, because I tested whether the geometry ALLOWED my route instead of whether the evidence REQUIRED it. Consequence: the 125 mm screed-fall warning and the G4C penetration were both consequences of an element that is not there.
